data class [AuthConfig](-auth-config/index.html) @[ExperimentalAuthApi](../com.google.adk.kt.annotations/-experimental-auth-api/index.html) constructor(val authScheme: [AuthScheme](-auth-scheme/index.html), val rawAuthCredential: [AuthCredential](-auth-credential/index.html)? = null, val exchangedAuthCredential: [AuthCredential](-auth-credential/index.html)? = null, val credentialKey: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html) = deriveCredentialKey(authScheme, rawAuthCredential))

What a tool needs to authenticate to a service: the scheme the service expects, and the tool's credentials. Creating a config or reading its properties requires `@OptIn(ExperimentalAuthApi::class)`; holding one, as [EventActions](../com.google.adk.kt.events/-event-actions/index.html) does, does not.

@[ExperimentalAuthApi](../com.google.adk.kt.annotations/-experimental-auth-api/index.html)

sealed interface [AuthCredential](-auth-credential/index.html)

A credential that a tool uses to call a service: an [ApiKey](-auth-credential/-api-key/index.html), an [Http](-auth-credential/-http/index.html) credential, an [OAuth2](-auth-credential/-o-auth2/index.html) or OpenID Connect credential, or a [ServiceAccount](-auth-credential/-service-account/index.html).

@[ExperimentalAuthApi](../com.google.adk.kt.annotations/-experimental-auth-api/index.html)

sealed interface [AuthScheme](-auth-scheme/index.html)

How a service expects a tool to authenticate, such as with an API key, an HTTP credential or OAuth2. Most schemes match OpenAPI security schemes; [OpenIdConnect](-auth-scheme/-open-id-connect/index.html) gives a provider's endpoints directly.
